bugs.why: the controller reads the filter from ?kind= instead of ?type=, so the type filter is ignored

bugs.test: a transfer moves money between wallets
bugs.why: the transfer route is registered as /transfer, so POST /api/transfers gets a 404
bugs.fix: The path is /transfers (plural), as in the README.

bugs.test: lists a wallet's transactions, newest first
bugs.why: the transactions route names its path parameter :walletId, but the controller reads req.params.id, so it never finds the wallet
bugs.fix: Name the parameter :id in the route, like the other wallet routes (or read the same name in the controller).

bugs.why: a transfer takes the money out of the sender before checking the recipient, so a transfer to a missing or frozen wallet loses the money
bugs.fix: Look up and check both wallets (and the balance) before recording either side.
